Stagehand selector+relevant-subtree SHA256 recomputed after mutation achieves HIT 0.94 on identical but MISS 0.0 false_accept 1.0 due to invalid drift injection target and 33/40 fallback selectors, speedup 0.44x inverted artifact, <30 families attempted, so no HIT>=0.8/MISS>=0.8/false_accept<0.05 bound. WebGym 300k diverse-site duplication and threshold sweep unmeasured. Gate0 relaxed/strict 0/10 even with 110 transitions/family (NL=3 strata=3) unblocks no physics correlated-state pilot. C-CROSSSITE remains HYPOTHESIS (single Magento store), C-LLM-INHERIT/C-PRODUCT-ECON remain HYPOTHESIS, no within-store family holdout validated, no product promotion justified.
